S1.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
S1.answer:
- **Get Clássica:** built for faster payments and receipt printing (paper roll). It has a 3G chip + Wi-Fi, accepts contactless and Pix via QR Code, and costs R$ 79,90/month unless you bill R$ 10.000/month, in which case it's free. (https://www.santander.com.br/blog/seus-negocios/solucoes-getnet/)
- **Get Smart:** built for fuller management, with order-to-payment integration. It has a 3G chip with a free data plan + Wi-Fi, accepts contactless and Pix, and costs R$ 129,90/month unless you bill R$ 60.000/month, in which case it's free. (https://www.santander.com.br/blog/seus-negocios/solucoes-getnet/)
- **Pricing thresholds:** https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/termos_e_condicoes_aluguel.pdf
- **Get Smart extras:** it runs Android and supports API integration. (https://www.getnet.net/en/our-solutions/in-person-payments)

S4.message: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?
S4.answer:
Yes. To sell with Pix on Get Tap, you need to enable the feature and link a bank account in the Getnet Brasil app. In the app, go to "Serviços" > "Venda com Pix" > "Habilitar", then choose your bank and follow the on-screen instructions to link the account that will receive the Pix payments.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix-no-get-tap-mais-agilidade-e-eficiencia-das-vendas/

S5.message: My card machine won't connect to the internet, what should I do?
S5.answer:
Your terminal (serial GS-77A1) is offline right now. It uses Wi-Fi, and the signal is weak, which is the most likely cause. It was last online on 2026-11-13 at 15:14.

Check the Wi-Fi connection on the terminal:
- **Get Smart:** On the home screen, tap "Configurar" > "Conexões" > "Wi-Fi", then pick your network. "Teste de Conexão" is in the same menu.
- **Get Clássica:** Tap WI-FI or Suporte > Habilitar Wi-Fi > Procurar Redes, select your network and enter the password. It also has a free 3G chip you can use instead.

Battery is at 42%, and firmware 4.3.0 is available (you're on 4.2.1). If it still won't connect, I can open a ticket for our human team to look into it.

S6.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
S6.answer:
Receivables advance lets you receive credit card sales (lump-sum or installment) before their original scheduled dates, in exchange for a fee. It isn't a loan: you get money that is already yours, with no new debt. Eligible sales depend on your contracted solution. (https://site.getnet.com.br/quando-vale-a-pena-antecipar-as-suas-vendas-no-cartao/)

In the Getnet Brasil app, you can view available receivables, simulate the advance, and see the net amount before confirming. (https://site.getnet.com.br/quando-vale-a-pena-antecipar-as-suas-vendas-no-cartao/)

On the Get Smart terminal: Payment > Antecipação > enter merchant password > select card brand > consult/simulate > "Antecipar" > enter the advance code > a receipt is printed. (https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Manul-GetSmart.pdf)

S9.message: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
S9.answer:
With Crediário Getnet you can split a sale into up to 48 installments. The maximum number of installments and the fees depend on the customer's issuing bank (e.g., up to 24x for Gerais, up to 48x for Santander), and the customer needs enough available credit card limit for the full purchase amount.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Folder_Credirio.pdf

S10.message: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
S10.answer:
Yes. Getnet's Payment Link lets you create a customizable link and send it via WhatsApp, social networks, email, or any other digital channel. The customer pays by credit card, debit, or Pix, with no need for a card machine.
